underlying_release: libxml2 2.15.4 and PHP 8.5.12 ext/dom DOMDocument::loadXML (AFL++ overlay, source build); Ubuntu PHP 8.5.4 with libxml 2.15.2 via php8.5-xml (Xdebug coverage image)
coverage_limit: Xdebug line coverage sees only querypath/querypath PHP lines and is reported separately. AFL++ feedback comes from the native overlay: libxml2 2.15.4 parser.c, parserInternals.c and SAX2.c plus PHP 8.5.12 ext/dom/document.c, instrumented through an allowlist while the same harness runs; libxml2 tree/XPath code, other ext/dom classes, ext/libxml and the interpreted querypath/querypath code add no AFL++ tuples. querypath/querypath is a loader over DOMDocument::loadXML (libxml2 family, shared with the standard DOMDocument path, symfony/dom-crawler, symfony/serializer and mtownsend/xml-to-array); its own lines are visible only in the Xdebug report. The pinned base image does not bundle php-fuzzer; replay is per case.
coverage: Xdebug executed line coverage in querypath/querypath 3.0.5 PHP source while it loads the valid XML; AFL++ feedback comes from the allowlisted libxml2 XML parser and PHP ext/dom loading sources in the native overlay
api: qp(string $xml) (QueryPath::with) on the local bytes, which DOMQuery::parseXMLString loads with DOMDocument::loadXML because the string starts with an XML declaration; DOMQuery::document() returns that DOMDocument, walked namespace-aware
